I couldn't set up the daily brief. The scheduler rejected both the list and add requests because the gateway has no credentials configured, so nothing is scheduled. I posted that in #strategic-random as a reply to you.

Once an operator fixes the gateway auth, I can add the job. It would run at 07:45 America/Chicago every day, starting tomorrow (Thu 15 Oct). It would post to #strategic-random and cover the last 24 hours in #strategic-pod, #strategic-random and #inc-vtg-hartford. I'd leave out money terms and anything from direct messages. Everyone in #strategic-random is already in all three channels, so the brief wouldn't reveal anything new to them.
